text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend three candidates to City Council for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO live.

City Council on May 20 and 21, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Board of Directors of TO Live, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on May 23, 2030, and until successors are appointed: Carole Beaulieu Claire Hopkinson Laura Wu 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b and 2 to 4 to the report (May 6, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.
